# Zennopay Documentation

> Zennopay provides two products through one HMAC-authenticated API foundation. QR Payments embeds a native merchant-QR checkout in a partner app. Platform Payouts lets a partner backend send asynchronous bank transfers to beneficiaries from an environment-scoped prefunded balance. Their resources, statuses, destinations, and webhooks are separate. Every page below is available as plain Markdown by appending `.md` to its URL.

## Start here

- [Build with Zennopay](https://docs.zennopay.com/introduction.md): Choose QR Payments or Platform Payouts.
- [How the products fit together](https://docs.zennopay.com/how-zennopay-works.md): Compare resource, client, money, and delivery models.
- [Authentication](https://docs.zennopay.com/authentication.md): Implement the shared HMAC signing contract and QR-specific client tokens.
- [Environments](https://docs.zennopay.com/api-reference/environments.md): Keep sandbox and live credentials, balances, and resources isolated.
- [Reconciliation](https://docs.zennopay.com/concepts/settlement.md): Recover authoritative state after retries, duplicates, and timeouts.

## QR Payments guides

- [QR Payments](https://docs.zennopay.com/qr-payments/overview.md): Product overview and integration map.
- [QR Payments quickstart](https://docs.zennopay.com/quickstart.md): Create a sandbox intent and present PaymentSheet.
- [QR Payments funds flow](https://docs.zennopay.com/concepts/funds-flow.md): Follow a prefunded payment through merchant delivery.
- [QR Payments corridors](https://docs.zennopay.com/concepts/corridors.md): Check scheme, currency, and execution availability.
- [QR Payments limits](https://docs.zennopay.com/fundamentals/limits.md): Understand per-user corridor enforcement.
- [PaymentSheet](https://docs.zennopay.com/payments/overview.md): Understand the native checkout surface.
- [Build your session endpoint](https://docs.zennopay.com/payments/session-endpoint.md): Connect a partner backend to PaymentSheet.
- [iOS](https://docs.zennopay.com/payments/ios.md): Install and present the iOS SDK.
- [Android](https://docs.zennopay.com/payments/android.md): Install and present the Android SDK.
- [Flutter](https://docs.zennopay.com/payments/flutter.md): Integrate the Flutter package.
- [React Native](https://docs.zennopay.com/payments/react-native.md): Link and call the native bridge.
- [Test QR Payments](https://docs.zennopay.com/payments/testing.md): Run sandbox and recovery scenarios.
- [Reopen a receipt](https://docs.zennopay.com/payments/reopen-receipt.md): Present the current receipt for a past payment.

## API reference

- [API reference](https://docs.zennopay.com/api-reference/overview.md): Shared conventions and product-specific reference routes.
- [API playground](https://docs.zennopay.com/api-reference/playground.md): Exercise the QR Payments and Platform Payouts OpenAPI contract in sandbox.

### QR Payments

- [Create payment intent](https://docs.zennopay.com/api-reference/payment-intents/create.md): `POST /v1/payment_intents`.
- [Re-mint session token](https://docs.zennopay.com/api-reference/payment-intents/session.md): `POST /v1/payment_intents/{id}/session`.
- [Scan merchant QR](https://docs.zennopay.com/api-reference/payment-intents/scan.md): `POST /v1/payment_intents/{id}/scan`.
- [Confirm payment intent](https://docs.zennopay.com/api-reference/payment-intents/confirm.md): `POST /v1/payment_intents/{id}/confirm`.
- [Get payment intent](https://docs.zennopay.com/api-reference/payment-intents/get.md): `GET /v1/payment_intents/{id}`.
- [Mint receipt token](https://docs.zennopay.com/api-reference/payment-intents/receipt-token.md): `POST /v1/payment_intents/{id}/receipt_token`.
- [Get receipt](https://docs.zennopay.com/api-reference/payment-intents/receipt.md): `GET /v1/payment_intents/{id}/receipt`.
- [QR Payments webhooks](https://docs.zennopay.com/api-reference/webhooks.md): Verify payment-intent events.

## Platform Payouts

- [Platform Payouts](https://docs.zennopay.com/platform-payouts/overview.md): Product overview, lifecycle, and integration map.
- [Platform Payouts quickstart](https://docs.zennopay.com/platform-payouts/quickstart.md): Create and track a sandbox payout.
- [Beneficiaries](https://docs.zennopay.com/platform-payouts/beneficiaries.md): Create reusable bank destinations.
- [Payouts API](https://docs.zennopay.com/platform-payouts/payouts.md): Create, retrieve, list, and interpret payouts.
- [Payout webhooks](https://docs.zennopay.com/platform-payouts/webhooks.md): Verify payout lifecycle events.
- [Test Platform Payouts](https://docs.zennopay.com/platform-payouts/testing.md): Exercise deterministic sandbox outcomes.
